title: Moving boulders of the Mojave racetrack

tellings.quote: The story of the moving boulders in the Mojave Desert.

plain: Michael Shermer, a researcher known as a skeptic, brings up the story of the moving boulders in the Mojave Desert in California: big rocks that seem to have shifted across the desert floor with no one moving them. He mentions it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, in a debate about UFOs, as an example of a strange story told about a place.
